title: Design System: Valorant Sensitivity Flight Deck

shadows.name: panel-structural
shadows.purpose: Directional depth for the continuous console.

motion.name: damped-needle
motion.purpose: Physical needle settling and panel-state transitions.

components.name: Primary Control
components.description: The single dominant action on an operational screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{min-height:44px;padding:9px 16px;border:1px solid #bff39c;border-radius:6px;background:#9be564;color:#071004;font:600 .78rem/1.2 Bahnschrift,'Arial Narrow',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.04em;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.42),0 3px 0 #38572b,0 7px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.46);transition:transform .18s cubic-bezier(.2,.85,.22,1),filter .18s ease}.ds-btn-primary:hover{filter:brightness(1.08);transform:translateY(-1px)}.ds-btn-primary:active{transform:translateY(2px);box-shadow:inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.25),0 1px 0 #38572b}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #d7ffb4;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Secondary Control
components.description: A machined graphite action that remains subordinate.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary{min-height:44px;padding:9px 16px;border:1px solid #050706;border-radius:6px;background:#1b201d;color:#f1f0df;font:600 .78rem/1.2 Bahnschrift,'Arial Narrow',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.04em;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.08),0 3px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.55);transition:transform .18s cubic-bezier(.2,.85,.22,1),filter .18s ease}.ds-btn-secondary:hover{filter:brightness(1.13);transform:translateY(-1px)}.ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #d7ffb4;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Numeric Input
components.description: An inset instrument readout for DPI and sensitivity.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="number" value="0.320" aria-label="当前游戏灵敏度">

components.name: Instrument Gauge
components.description: One literal metric in a recessed circular well.
components.css: .ds-gauge{width:190px;aspect-ratio:1;display:grid;place-content:center;gap:6px;text-align:center;border:9px solid #202521;border-radius:50%;background:#070908;color:#b8b9aa;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #000,inset 0 0 26px rgba(0,0,0,.92),0 6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.62);font-family:'Segoe UI',sans-serif}.ds-gauge strong{padding:2px 8px;border:1px solid #2b342a;border-radius:3px;background:#060906;color:#c9f6a6;font:600 1.5rem/1.2 Bahnschrift,'Arial Narrow',sans-serif}.ds-gauge small{color:#7d8279;font:600 .64rem/1.2 Bahnschrift,'Arial Narrow',sans-serif}

narrative.overview: A small aircraft crossing darkness by trusted instruments alone. Every dial owns one truth, the eye follows a practiced cross-check, and state is conveyed by measured needle movement rather than decorative spectacle.
keyCharacteristics: Fixed instrument constellations with a clear cross-check order.
Near-black matte material, luminous marks, and restrained caution colors.
Physical, damped transitions that show trend as well as value.
Direct operating language; metaphor never replaces the real metric.

rules.name: The Caution Lamp Rule
rules.body: Amber and red are state signals, never decoration.

rules.name: The Instrument Truth Rule
rules.body: Metric labels and values remain literal, never cockpit jargon.

rules.name: The Panel Rule
rules.body: Surfaces belong to one physical console; they do not float independently.

dos: Do let each instrument own one plainly named truth.
Do use damped needle motion and short mechanical state feedback.
Do preserve a stable cross-check order across result and history views.
Do provide visual equivalents for every sound cue.
Do let the canvas dominate every active aim-test state.
Do use monotonic timing and pause visibly when focus or pointer lock is lost.
donts: Don't turn the interface into a neon esports HUD or glass card dashboard.
Don't use warning colors for emphasis unrelated to system state.
Don't hide task progress or controls behind the cockpit metaphor.
Don't crowd the active aim field with decorative telemetry.
Don't animate layout properties when a transform can carry the same state.
Don't present community-measured conversion constants as Riot-official data.
